name: Malevolent Haze
body:
School conjuration (creation); Level death mage 6, magus 6, sorcerer/wizard 6, unchained summoner 6

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a vial of rancid blood)

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level.

Effect fog spreads in 20-ft. radius, 20 ft. high
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

Malevolent haze creates a shifting and moving cloud of blood-red vapor that functions like the solid fog spell.

In addition to slowing down creatures and obscuring sight, the vile vapors sap the life out of living creatures.

Each round on your turn, and when the spell is first cast, the fog deals 2d6 negative energy damage to each living creature within it. This spell does not heal undead creatures.
